queries.query:
// What the controller says it is doing, newest reading in the last day.
// "read" is how long ago it last reported. Words and numbers are read apart,
// since one stream holding both is a type conflict.

import "strings"

errors = (v) =>
    if v == 0 then "none"
        else if v == 2 then "battery volts too high"
        else if v == 17 then "charger too hot"
        else if v == 18 then "charger over current"
        else if v == 19 then "charger current reversed"
        else if v == 20 then "bulk time limit reached"
        else if v == 21 then "current sensor fault"
        else if v == 26 then "terminals too hot"
        else if v == 28 then "converter fault"
        else if v == 33 then "panel volts too high"
        else if v == 34 then "panel current too high"
        else if v == 38 then "input off: battery volts too high"
        else if v == 39 then "input off: current while switched off"
        else if v == 65 then "lost contact with a networked device"
        else if v == 66 then "synchronised charging misconfigured"
        else if v == 67 then "BMS connection lost"
        else if v == 68 then "network misconfigured"
        else if v == 116 then "calibration data lost"
        else if v == 117 then "firmware incompatible"
        else if v == 119 then "settings invalid"
        else "error " + string(v: v)

off = (v) =>
    strings.trimSuffix(
    v:
        (if v / 1 % 2 == 1 then "no panel power, " else "") +
        (if v / 2 % 2 == 1 then "power switch off, " else "") +
        (if v / 4 % 2 == 1 then "switched off in settings, " else "") +
        (if v / 8 % 2 == 1 then "remote input, " else "") +
        (if v / 16 % 2 == 1 then "protection, " else "") +
        (if v / 32 % 2 == 1 then "pay as you go, " else "") +
        (if v / 64 % 2 == 1 then "BMS, " else "") +
        (if v / 128 % 2 == 1 then "engine shutdown detected, " else "") +
        (if v / 256 % 2 == 1 then "checking panel volts, " else "") +
        (if v >= 512 then "other bits " + string(v: v - v % 512) + ", " else ""),
    suffix: ", ",
)

ago = (t) => string(v: duration(v: (int(v: now()) - int(v: t)) / 1000000000 * 1000000000))

mppt = (fields) =>
    from(bucket: "raw")
        |> range(start: -1d)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt" and r._field =~ fields)

words = mppt(fields: /^(charge_state|tracker)$/)
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> last()
    |> map(
        fn: (r) =>
            ({r with
                _value:
                    if r._value == "mppt_active" then
                        "tracking"
                    else
                        strings.replaceAll(v: r._value, t: "_", u: " "),
            }),
    )

codes = mppt(fields: /^(error|off_reason_code)$/)
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> last()
    |> map(
        fn: (r) =>
            ({r with
                _value:
                    if r._field == "error" then
                        errors(v: int(v: r._value))
                    else if r._value == 0.0 then
                        "none"
                    else
                        off(v: int(v: r._value)),
            }),
    )

states = union(tables: [words |> group(), codes |> group()])

read = states
    |> max(column: "_time")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "read", _value: ago(t: r._time) + " ago"}))

union(tables: [states, read])
    |> keep(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "_value"])
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_volts")
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_amps")
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_watts")
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pv_volts")
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pv_amps")
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pv_watts")
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

// The controller's yield by local day, from its lifetime total, the way the
// daily energy query works out solar_wh. Each day is drawn from its midnight
// to a second before the next.

import "date"
import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Chicago")

start = date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1d)

daily = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: date.sub(d: 1h, from: start), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt" and r._field == "yield_total_kwh")
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> difference(nonNegative: true)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value and r._time >= start)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({day: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 1d), kwh: r._value}))
    |> group(columns: ["day"])
    |> sum(column: "kwh")
    |> group()

union(
    tables: [
        daily |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r.day, _field: "yield", _value: r.kwh})),
        daily |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: date.sub(d: 1s, from: date.add(d: 1d, to: r.day)), _field: "yield", _value: r.kwh})),
    ],
)
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
